subject.title: Feature: configurable mediaLocalRoots for image tool

question: Should OpenClaw accept a shared operator-controlled host-root policy for image/media tool reads, and if so should it be the broader `tools.fs.roots` contract rather than a separate `tools.image.mediaLocalRoots` field?
rationale: The requested fix is useful but changes the host filesystem/media access boundary, adds config surface, and overlaps an open broad PR; automation should not choose the permanent security/product contract.

options.title: Adopt shared `tools.fs.roots` policy
options.body: Refresh or replace the open broader PR so one reviewed root contract covers filesystem tools, local media reads, outbound media, docs, and tests.

options.title: Add a narrow media-only root field
options.body: Implement only image/PDF/media-tool extra roots, accepting a smaller diff but creating a second access-policy surface beside filesystem tools.

options.title: Decline broad host roots for now
options.body: Keep safe defaults plus channel-scoped inbound roots and document copy/sandbox/workspace workflows instead of adding a new host-root knob.

recommendation.title: Adopt shared `tools.fs.roots` policy
recommendation.body: Refresh or replace the open broader PR so one reviewed root contract covers filesystem tools, local media reads, outbound media, docs, and tests.

likelyOwner.reason: The current main media-root and schema lines are attributed to recent Vincent Koc work in this checkout, and the iMessage root behavior was recently updated in the same area.
